description: This file contains functions and components for rendering chat message groups, including avatars, message bubbles, tool cards, JSON detection, and TTS controls, within a web UI using lit-html.

methods.name: extractImages
methods.description: Extracts image blocks from a message object, handling different formats and sources.

methods.name: renderReadingIndicatorGroup
methods.description: Renders a chat group with a reading indicator for the assistant.

methods.name: renderStreamingGroup
methods.description: Renders a streaming assistant message with timestamp and avatar.

methods.name: renderMessageGroup
methods.description: Renders a complete message group including avatar, messages, metadata, and controls.

methods.name: extractGroupMeta
methods.description: Aggregates token usage, cost, model, and context percentage for a message group.

methods.name: fmtTokens
methods.description: Formats token counts into a compact string (e.g., 128k).

methods.name: renderMessageMeta
methods.description: Renders metadata such as token counts, cache, cost, model, and context percentage.

methods.name: extractGroupText
methods.description: Concatenates text content from all messages in a group.

methods.name: shouldSkipDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Checks local storage to determine if delete confirmation should be skipped.

methods.name: createDeleteConfirmPopover
methods.description: Creates a confirmation popover for message deletion.

methods.name: renderDeleteButton
methods.description: Renders a delete button with confirmation logic.

methods.name: renderTtsButton
methods.description: Renders a button to trigger TTS (text-to-speech) for a message group.

methods.name: renderAvatar
methods.description: Renders avatar or icon for a user, assistant, or tool role.

methods.name: isAvatarUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid avatar URL.

methods.name: renderMessageImages
methods.description: Renders images attached to a message, with click-to-open functionality.

methods.name: renderCollapsedToolCards
methods.description: Renders a collapsible list of tool cards.

methods.name: detectJson
methods.description: Detects if a string is a JSON object or array and returns a pretty-printed version.

methods.name: jsonSummaryLabel
methods.description: Creates a short label summarizing JSON content.

methods.name: renderExpandButton
methods.description: Renders a button to expand content in a sidebar.

methods.name: renderGroupedMessage
methods.description: Renders an individual message bubble with optional JSON, images, and tool cards.
